title: Text and binary inputs for protobuf requests to custom model serving endpoints (Public Preview)
body:
Protobuf requests to [custom model serving endpoints](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/custom-models) can now carry text and binary data, such as titles, images, audio, and documents, as KServe v2 `BYTES` tensors alongside numeric tensors in the same request. Text and binary model outputs are returned as `BYTES` tensors.

This feature is in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) and is only available on endpoints deployed after November 10, 2026. See [Protobuf tensor input](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/score-custom-model-endpoints#protobuf-tensor-input).
